audit_items.proof_trace: The Merkle proof at L727-735 binds both `amount` and the full `investorVestingConfig` (including `tokenAllocationOnTGERate`) so neither can be altered by the investor. `amountToBeVested = amount - (amount * rate / 1e18)` is deterministic and bounded by `_verifyValidVestingConfig` (rate <= 1e18). When `amountToBeVested > 0`, `SafeTransferLib.safeTransfer(askToken, vestingAddress, amountToBeVested)` transfers exactly that amount; the function reverts on any failure, so the vesting contract always receives exactly the designated vesting portion.
